units.zh: 列傳一百四十
units.en: Biographies 140
units.literal: Biographies 140

units.zh: 達椿子薩彬圖鐵保弟玉保和瑛覺羅桂芳
units.en: Da Chun; his son Sa Bintu; Tie Bao; Tie Bao's younger brother Yu Bao; He Ying; and Jueluo Guifang
units.literal: Da Chun; son: Sa Bintu; Tie Bao; younger brother: Yu Bao; He Ying; Jueluo Guifang

units.zh: 達椿，字香圃，烏蘇氏，滿洲鑲白旗人。
units.en: Da Chun, whose courtesy name was Xiangpu, came from the Wusu clan and was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner.
units.literal: Da Chun, courtesy name Xiangpu, of the Wusu clan, a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner.

units.zh: 乾隆二十五年進士，選庶吉士，散館授戶部主事，遷員外郎。
units.en: He took his jinshi degree in 1760, entered the Hanlin as a probationer academician, and on leaving the academy was posted to the Ministry of Revenue as a principal secretary before rising to vice director.
units.literal: In the twenty-fifth year of Qianlong he passed the jinshi examination, was selected as a bachelor of the Hanlin Academy, and upon leaving the academy was appointed a principal secretary in the Ministry of Revenue; he was promoted to vice director.

units.zh: 歷翰林院侍講、侍讀、國子監祭酒、詹事府詹事、大理寺卿。
units.en: He rose through the Hanlin as reader- and tutor-in-waiting, then became chancellor of the Imperial Academy, grand tutor in the Heir Apparent's household, and president of the Court of Judicial Review.
units.literal: He successively served as Hanlin reader-in-waiting, tutor-in-waiting, chancellor of the Imperial Academy, grand tutor in the Household of the Heir Apparent, and president of the Court of Judicial Review.

units.zh: 二十九年，入直上書房，充四庫全書總閱，累擢禮部侍郎，兼副都統。
units.en: In 1764 he joined the Southern Study, served as chief reviewer for the Siku Quanshu project, and was promoted step by step to vice minister of rites with a concurrent post as deputy lieutenant-general.
units.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he entered service in the Southern Study, served as general reviewer of the Complete Library of the Four Treasuries, and was repeatedly promoted to vice minister of rites while concurrently holding the post of deputy lieutenant-general.

units.zh: 四十五年，坐會同四譯館屋壞，斃朝鮮使臣，革職留任。
units.en: In 1780 the Joint Four Translation Offices building collapsed and killed a Korean envoy; he was demoted but allowed to remain at his post.
units.literal: In the forty-fifth year, because the building of the Joint Four Translation Offices collapsed and killed a Korean envoy, he was stripped of office but retained in his post.

units.zh: 五十四年，左遷內閣學士。
units.en: In 1789 he was demoted to academician of the Grand Secretariat.
units.literal: In the fifty-fourth year he was demoted to academician of the Grand Secretariat.

units.zh: 達椿直內廷，不附和珅，數媒孽其短，以曠直褫職，仍留上書房效力行走。
units.en: Da Chun served in the inner court with integrity and refused to align with Heshen, who repeatedly spread slander against him. Cited for absenteeism, he was stripped of rank but kept on in the Southern Study to perform duties.
units.literal: Da Chun was upright in the inner court and would not attach himself to Heshen; Heshen repeatedly slandered him, and on a charge of absenteeism he was dismissed from office but was kept in the Southern Study to serve on duty.

units.zh: 尋授翰林院侍講學士，复迭以大考降黜授檢討。
units.en: He was soon made Hanlin reader-in-waiting, but repeated poor showings in the triennial examination reduced him again and again, until he held only the rank of reviser.
units.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed Hanlin reader-in-waiting; again and again he was demoted in the triennial examination and was appointed reviser.

units.zh: 仁宗知其屈抑，至嘉慶四年，詔：「達椿因曠班被譴，其過輕，當時劉墉亦緣此降官；
units.en: Emperor Renzong knew he had been treated unfairly. In 1799 an edict declared: 'Da Chun was censured for absenteeism, yet the fault was slight; Liu Yong was demoted for the same reason at the time;
units.literal: Emperor Renzong knew he had been wronged; by the fourth year of Jiaqing an edict said: 'Da Chun was punished for absenteeism, but the offense was slight; at the time Liu Yong was also demoted for the same reason;

units.zh: 今劉墉已為大學士，達椿尚未遷擢，加恩補授內閣學士兼副都統。」
units.en: Liu Yong is already a grand secretary, while Da Chun has still not been advanced. Let favor be shown by restoring him as academician of the Grand Secretariat with concurrent duty as deputy lieutenant-general.'
units.literal: now Liu Yong is already a grand secretary, while Da Chun has still not been promoted; grace is extended to appoint him grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat with concurrent duty as deputy lieutenant-general.'

units.zh: 子薩彬圖，時亦同官，命達椿班次列薩彬圖之前。
units.en: His son Sa Bintu then held the same rank; the court ordered Da Chun to take precedence over his son in seniority.
units.literal: His son Sa Bintu held the same office at the time; Da Chun was ordered to rank before Sa Bintu in precedence.'

units.zh: 歷禮部、吏部侍郎，兼翰林院掌院學士，擢左都御史兼都統，遷禮部尚書。
units.en: He served as vice minister of rites and of personnel, concurrently as chancellor of the Hanlin, then rose to censor-in-chief with a concurrent lieutenant-general's commission, and finally became minister of rites.
units.literal: He successively served as vice minister of rites and of personnel, concurrently as chancellor of the Hanlin Academy; he was promoted to censor-in-chief with concurrent duty as lieutenant-general, then transferred to minister of rites.

units.zh: 六年，典會試。
units.en: In 1801 he presided over the metropolitan civil service examination.
units.literal: In the sixth year he presided over the metropolitan examination.

units.zh: 七年，卒。
units.en: He died in 1802.
units.literal: In the seventh year he died.

units.zh: 薩彬圖，乾隆四十五年進士，授戶部主事，遷員外郎。
units.en: Sa Bintu took his jinshi degree in 1780, entered the Ministry of Revenue as a principal secretary, and rose to vice director.
units.literal: Sa Bintu, jinshi in the forty-fifth year of Qianlong, was appointed principal secretary in the Ministry of Revenue and promoted to vice director.

units.zh: 典貴州鄉試，改歷翰詹，累遷內閣學士兼副都統。
units.en: After supervising the Guizhou provincial examination he moved through the Hanlin and Heir Apparent's household and was promoted step by step to academician of the Grand Secretariat with a concurrent post as deputy lieutenant-general.
units.literal: He presided over the Guizhou provincial examination, transferred through the Hanlin and Household of the Heir Apparent, and was repeatedly promoted to grand secretary with concurrent duty as deputy lieutenant-general.

units.zh: 和珅既伏法，仁宗不欲株連興獄，而薩彬圖屢疏言和珅財產多寄頓隱匿，有嘗管金銀使女四名，請獨至慎刑司訊鞫。
units.en: After Heshen's execution the emperor did not want a widening purge, but Sa Bintu repeatedly memorialized that much of Heshen's wealth had been hidden away and that four maidservants who had managed his bullion should be interrogated separately in the Imperial Prison.
units.literal: After Heshen had been executed, Emperor Renzong did not wish to extend prosecutions, yet Sa Bintu repeatedly memorialized that much of Heshen's property had been deposited and concealed, that there were four maidservants who had managed his gold and silver, and requested that they be examined alone in the Imperial Prison.

units.zh: 詔嚴斥之，命從王大臣訊，不得實，議革職，予七品筆帖式，效力萬年吉地。
units.en: The throne sharply rebuked him and had princes and grand ministers conduct the inquiry. When nothing was substantiated, he was stripped of office, given a seventh-rank clerkship, and sent to serve at the imperial mausoleum works.
units.literal: An edict sternly rebuked him and ordered that the case be tried with princes and grand ministers; nothing was proved, and it was proposed to strip him of office and give him a seventh-rank clerk's post to serve at the Wan-nian auspicious burial ground.

units.zh: 尋以其父年老，召還京，授戶部主事，累擢倉場侍郎。
units.en: Soon afterward, on account of his father's age, he was recalled to Beijing, reappointed a principal secretary in the Ministry of Revenue, and rose step by step to vice minister in charge of the capital granaries.
units.literal: Soon, because his father was old, he was recalled to the capital, appointed principal secretary in the Ministry of Revenue, and was repeatedly promoted to vice minister in charge of the granaries.

units.zh: 十二年，出為漕運總督。
units.en: In 1807 he was posted as director-general of grain transport.
units.literal: In the twelfth year he went out as director-general of grain transport.

units.zh: 逾三歲，京倉虧缺事覺，降光祿寺卿。
units.en: More than three years later shortages in the capital granaries were exposed, and he was demoted to president of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
units.literal: After more than three years the shortfall in the capital granaries came to light, and he was demoted to president of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

units.zh: 遷盛京戶部侍郎，十六年，坐奉天災民流徙出邊，褫職。
units.en: He was transferred to vice minister of revenue for Mukden. In 1811, blamed for famine in Fengtian and refugees crossing the frontier, he was stripped of office.
units.literal: He was transferred to vice minister of revenue for Mukden; in the sixteenth year, because of famine in Fengtian and people fleeing across the border, he was dismissed.

units.zh: 尋卒。
units.en: He died soon afterward.
units.literal: He soon died.

units.zh: 鐵保，字冶亭，棟鄂氏，滿洲正黃旗人。
units.en: Tie Bao, whose courtesy name was Yeting, came from the Donggo clan and was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.
units.literal: Tie Bao, courtesy name Yeting, of the Donggo clan, a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.

units.zh: 先世姓覺羅，稱為趙宋之裔，後改今氏。
units.en: His forebears had borne the surname Jueluo and were claimed as descendants of the Song house; the family later adopted its present clan name.
units.literal: His ancestors bore the surname Jueluo and were said to be descendants of the Song of Zhao; later they changed to the present clan name.

units.zh: 父誠泰，泰宁鎮總兵，世為將家。
units.en: His father Cheng Tai was regional commander at Taining, and for generations the family had produced soldiers.
units.literal: His father Cheng Tai was regional commander at Taining; for generations the family had been a military house.

units.zh: 鐵保折節讀書，年二十一，成乾隆三十七年進士，授吏部主事，襲恩騎尉世職。
units.en: Tie Bao applied himself to learning and, at twenty-one, passed the jinshi examination in 1772. He entered the Ministry of Personnel as a principal secretary and inherited a hereditary enjiwei rank.
units.literal: Tie Bao bent himself to study; at twenty-one he became jinshi in the thirty-seventh year of Qianlong, was appointed principal secretary in the Ministry of Personnel, and inherited the hereditary enjiwei rank.

units.zh: 於曹司中介然孤立，意有不可，爭辯勿撓。
units.en: In the ministry he held himself apart with integrity: whenever he thought a matter unjust, he argued his case without yielding.
units.literal: In the ministry offices he stood apart with integrity; when he thought something wrong, he argued without yielding.

units.zh: 大學士阿桂屢薦之，遷郎中，擢少詹事，因事罷。
units.en: Grand Secretary Agui recommended him repeatedly. He rose to director and then junior grand tutor before being dismissed over a dispute.
units.literal: Grand Secretary Agui repeatedly recommended him; he was promoted to director, then to junior grand tutor, and was dismissed because of an affair.

units.zh: 尋補戶部員外郎，調吏部。
units.en: He was soon reappointed vice director in the Ministry of Revenue and transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.
units.literal: Soon he was reappointed vice director in the Ministry of Revenue and transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.

units.zh: 擢翰林院侍講學士，仍兼吏部行走，歷侍讀學士、內閣學士。
units.en: He was promoted to Hanlin reader-in-waiting while still serving in the Ministry of Personnel, then rose through reader and academician of the Grand Secretariat.
units.literal: He was promoted to Hanlin reader-in-waiting while still serving concurrently in the Ministry of Personnel, and passed through reader and grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat.

units.zh: 五十四年，遷禮部侍郎，兼副都統。
units.en: In 1789 he became vice minister of rites with a concurrent post as deputy lieutenant-general.
units.literal: In the fifty-fourth year he was transferred to vice minister of rites with concurrent duty as deputy lieutenant-general.

units.zh: 校射中的，賜花翎。
units.en: He scored a hit in the archery review and was awarded the peacock feather.
units.literal: In the archery review he hit the target and was granted the peacock feather.

units.zh: 調吏部。
units.en: He was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.
units.literal: He was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.

units.zh: 嘉慶四年，奏劾司員，帝責其過當，左遷內閣學士，轉盛京兵部、刑部侍郎，兼奉天府尹。
units.en: In 1799 he memorialized to impeach a clerk in his department; the emperor called his action excessive and demoted him to academician of the Grand Secretariat, then posted him to Mukden as vice minister of war and of punishments with concurrent duty as metropolitan magistrate of Fengtian.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing he memorialized impeaching a department clerk; the emperor rebuked him for excess and demoted him to grand secretary, then transferred him to vice minister of war and of punishments for Mukden, concurrently metropolitan magistrate of Fengtian.

units.zh: 尋復召為吏部侍郎，出為漕運總督。
units.en: He was soon recalled as vice minister of personnel and then appointed director-general of grain transport.
units.literal: Soon he was again recalled as vice minister of personnel and went out as director-general of grain transport.

units.zh: 五年，值車駕將幸盛京，疏請御道因舊址，勿闢新道；
units.en: In 1800, as the emperor was about to travel to Mukden, he memorialized that the imperial route should follow the old road rather than cut a new one;
units.literal: In the fifth year, as the imperial carriage was about to visit Mukden, he memorialized that the imperial route should follow the old line and not open a new road;

units.zh: 裁革餽送扈從官員土儀；
units.en: that local gifts to officials in the entourage be abolished;
units.literal: that gifts of local products to accompanying officials be abolished;

units.zh: 禁從官妄拿車馬：上嘉納之。
units.en: and that attendants be forbidden to requisition carts and horses at will. The emperor commended and adopted his proposals.
units.literal: and that attendants be forbidden to seize carts and horses at will: the emperor praised and accepted this.

units.zh: 七年，遷廣東巡撫，調山東。
units.en: In 1802 he was made governor of Guangdong and then transferred to Shandong.
units.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to governor of Guangdong, then to Shandong.

units.zh: 河決衡家樓，詔預籌運道。
units.en: When the Yellow River burst at Hengjialou, the court ordered plans for an alternate transport route.
units.literal: The Yellow River broke at Hengjialou; an edict ordered advance planning for the transport route.

units.zh: 九年三月，漕運迅速，加太子少保。
units.en: In March 1804 grain transport moved swiftly, and he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: In the third month of the ninth year grain transport was rapid, and he was given the title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 尋以水淺船遲，革職留任。
units.en: Soon afterward shallow water slowed the fleet; he was demoted but kept at his post.
units.literal: Soon, because the water was shallow and boats were delayed, he was stripped of office but retained in his post.

units.zh: 十年，擢兩江總督，命覆鞫安徽壽州武舉張大有妒姦毒斃族侄獄，蘇州知府週鍔受賄輕縱，及初彭齡為安徽巡撫，勘實置法。
units.en: In 1805 he was made governor-general of the Two Jiangs and ordered to reopen the case of Zhang Dayou, a military licentiate of Shouzhou in Anhui who had poisoned his clansman's son in a jealous adultery affair. The prefect of Suzhou, Zhou E, had taken bribes and let the matter go lightly until Governor Chu Pengling of Anhui verified the facts and punished those responsible.
units.literal: In the tenth year he was promoted to governor-general of the Two Jiangs and ordered to re-examine the case in which the military licentiate Zhang Dayou of Shouzhou, Anhui, had killed his clansman's son by poison out of jealousy and adultery; the prefect of Suzhou, Zhou E, had taken bribes and treated the case lightly, until Chu Pengling as governor of Anhui verified the facts and applied the law.

units.zh: 鐵保坐失察，褫宮銜，降二品頂戴，​​尋復之。
units.en: Tie Bao was blamed for inadequate oversight, stripped of his palace title, and reduced to second-rank insignia, which was soon restored.
units.literal: Tie Bao was punished for lack of supervision, stripped of his palace rank, and demoted to second-rank insignia; soon it was restored.

units.zh: 十二年，疏請八旗兵米酌給二成折色，詔斥妄改舊章，革職留任。
units.en: In 1807 he proposed that twenty percent of Banner grain rations be paid in commuted cash. The throne rebuked him for rashly altering established rules and demoted him while keeping him in office.
units.literal: In the twelfth year he memorialized that twenty percent of Banner troops' grain rations be paid in commuted cash; an edict rebuked him for rashly altering established regulations, and he was stripped of office but retained in his post.

units.zh: 先後疏論治河，請改建王營減壩，培築高堰、山盱堤后土坡及河岸大堤，修復雲梯關外海口，遣大臣勘議，並採其說施行。
units.en: He submitted a series of memorials on river works, urging reconstruction of the Wangying spillway, reinforcement of the Gaoyan and Shanxu rear slopes and the main river dikes, and repair of the seagate beyond Yuntiguan. The court sent grand ministers to inspect his plans and put many of them into effect.
units.literal: He repeatedly memorialized on river control, requesting reconstruction of the Wangying spillway, reinforcement of the Gaoyan and Shanxu rear slopes and the great river dikes, and repair of the seagate outside Yuntiguan; grand ministers were sent to survey and discuss, and his proposals were adopted and carried out.

units.zh: 十四年，運河屢壞堤，荷花塘決口合而復潰，鐫級留任。
units.en: In 1809 canal dikes failed repeatedly; the Hehuatang breach was sealed and then broke open again, and he was reduced in rank but kept in office.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year the Grand Canal dikes broke repeatedly; the breach at Hehuatang closed and then burst again, and he was demoted in rank but retained in his post.

units.zh: 山陽知縣王伸漢冒賑，酖殺委員李毓昌，至是事覺，詔斥鐵保偏聽固執，河工日壞，吏治日弛，釀成重獄，褫職，遣戍烏魯木齊。
units.en: Wang Shenhan, magistrate of Shanyang, had embezzled relief funds and poisoned Commissioner Li Yuchang; the crime now came to light. The throne rebuked Tie Bao for partiality and stubbornness, blamed him for worsening river works and slackening administration, stripped him of office, and sent him into exile at Urumqi.
units.literal: Wang Shenhan, magistrate of Shanyang, had embezzled relief funds and poisoned Commissioner Li Yuchang; now the affair came to light. An edict rebuked Tie Bao for partiality and obstinacy, saying river works grew worse daily and official discipline slackened daily, producing a grave case; he was stripped of office and sent in exile to Urumqi.

units.zh: 逾年，給三等侍衛，充葉爾羌辦事大臣。
units.en: A year later he was made a third-class bodyguard and appointed commissioner at Yarkand.
units.literal: After a year he was given the rank of third-class bodyguard and appointed commissioner at Yarkand.

units.zh: 尋授翰林院侍講學士，調喀什噶爾參贊大臣。
units.en: He was soon made Hanlin reader-in-waiting and transferred to assistant commissioner at Kashgar.
units.literal: Soon he was appointed Hanlin reader-in-waiting and transferred to assistant commissioner at Kashgar.

units.zh: 授浙江巡撫，未之任，改吏部侍郎。
units.en: He was named governor of Zhejiang but never took up the post and was instead made vice minister of personnel.
units.literal: He was appointed governor of Zhejiang but did not take up the post and was changed to vice minister of personnel.

units.zh: 擢禮部尚書，調吏部。
units.en: He rose to minister of rites and was transferred to head the Ministry of Personnel.
units.literal: He was promoted to minister of rites and transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.

units.zh: 請芟吏、兵兩部苛例，條陳時政，多見施行。
units.en: He asked that harsh precedents in the ministries of personnel and war be cut back, memorialized on current affairs, and saw many of his proposals adopted.
units.literal: He requested pruning of harsh precedents in the ministries of personnel and war, set forth current policy in articles, and many of his proposals were implemented.

units.zh: 林清之變，召對，極言內監通賊有據，因窮治逆黨，內監多銜恨，遍騰謗言。
units.en: During the Lin Qing uprising he was summoned to audience and argued forcefully that eunuchs had aided the rebels. His thorough pursuit of the conspiracy earned the hatred of many eunuchs, who spread slander against him far and wide.
units.literal: At the Lin Qing incident he was summoned for audience and strongly stated that there was evidence of eunuchs colluding with rebels; because he pursued the rebel party to the end, many eunuchs bore resentment and spread slander everywhere.

units.zh: 會伊犁將軍松筠劾鐵保前在喀什噶爾治叛裔玉素普之獄，誤聽人言，枉殺回民毛拉素皮等四人，上怒，追念江南李毓昌之獄，斥其屢蹈重咎，褫職，發往吉林效力。
units.en: When Ili General Songyun impeached Tie Bao for wrongly executing four Muslims, including Mullah Supi, in the case of the rebel Yusupu at Kashgar after heeding false reports, the emperor's anger revived memories of the Li Yuchang affair in the south. Rebuking him for repeated grave failures, the court stripped him of office and sent him to serve in Jilin.
units.literal: When Ili General Songyun impeached Tie Bao for, while at Kashgar earlier, hearing false reports in the case of the rebel descendant Yusupu and wrongly executing four Muslims including Mullah Supi, the emperor was angry, recalled the Li Yuchang case in Jiangnan, rebuked him for repeatedly incurring grave blame, stripped him of office, and sent him to serve in Jilin.

units.zh: 二十三年，召為司經局洗馬。
units.en: In 1818 he was recalled as groom of the Directorate of Education.
units.literal: In the twenty-third year he was recalled as groom of the Directorate of Education.

units.zh: 道光初，以疾乞休，賜三品卿銜。
units.en: Early in the Daoguang reign he retired on grounds of illness and was granted third-rank chamberlain rank.
units.literal: At the beginning of Daoguang, on grounds of illness he requested retirement and was granted third-rank chamberlain rank.

units.zh: 四年，卒。
units.en: He died in 1824.
units.literal: In the fourth year he died.

units.zh: 鐵保慷慨論事，高宗謂其有大臣風。
units.en: Tie Bao debated state affairs with bold candor, and Emperor Qianlong said he had the bearing of a great minister.
units.literal: Tie Bao spoke on affairs with generous forthrightness; Emperor Gaozong said he had the bearing of a great minister.

units.zh: 及居外任，自欲有所表見，倨傲，意為愛憎，屢以措施失當被黜。
units.en: In provincial office he was eager to make his mark, grew arrogant, let personal likes and dislikes guide him, and was repeatedly dismissed for misjudged policies.
units.literal: When he held provincial posts he wished to make a mark, was arrogant, acted from favor and dislike, and was repeatedly dismissed for improper measures.

units.zh: 然優於文學，詞翰並美。
units.en: Yet he excelled in letters, and both his prose and poetry were admired.
units.literal: Yet he excelled in letters, and both his prose and poetry were fine.

units.zh: 兩典禮闈及山東、順天鄉試，皆得人。
units.en: He twice presided over the metropolitan examination and over the Shandong and Shuntian provincial examinations, each time choosing able candidates.
units.literal: Twice he presided over the metropolitan examination and the Shandong and Shuntian provincial examinations, and in each case selected able men.

units.zh: 留心文獻，為八旗通志總裁。
units.en: He devoted himself to historical sources and served as chief compiler of the Comprehensive Gazetteer of the Eight Banners.
units.literal: He attended to historical documents and served as chief compiler of the Comprehensive Gazetteer of the Eight Banners.

units.zh: 多得開國以來滿洲、蒙古、漢軍遺集，先成白山詩介五十卷，復增輯改編，得一百三十四卷，進禦，仁宗制序，賜名熙朝雅頌集。
units.en: He gathered many surviving works by Manchu, Mongol, and Han Banner writers since the founding of the dynasty, first compiled the Baishan Shijie in fifty juan, then expanded and revised it to one hundred thirty-four juan. He presented it to the throne; Emperor Renzong wrote a preface and bestowed the title Elegant Odes of a Flourishing Age.
units.literal: He obtained many surviving collections of Manchu, Mongol, and Han Banner writers since the founding of the dynasty, first compiled the Baishan Shijie in fifty juan, then expanded and revised it to one hundred thirty-four juan, presented it to the throne, and Emperor Renzong wrote a preface and granted the title Xichao Yasong Ji.

units.zh: 自著曰懷清齋集。
units.en: His own collected writings were entitled the Huaiqing Studio Collection.
units.literal: His own collected writings are entitled Huaiqingzhai Ji.

units.zh: 弟玉保，字閬峰。
units.en: His younger brother Yu Bao, whose courtesy name was Langfeng.
units.literal: His younger brother Yu Bao, courtesy name Langfeng.

units.zh: 乾隆四十六年進士，入翰林，有才名。
units.en: He took his jinshi degree in 1781, entered the Hanlin, and won a reputation for literary talent.
units.literal: Jinshi in the forty-sixth year of Qianlong, he entered the Hanlin and had a reputation for talent.

units.zh: 高宗親試八旗翰詹，與兄鐵保並被擢，時比以郊、祁，軾、轍。
units.en: Emperor Qianlong personally examined the Banner Hanlin and Heir Apparent's household; he and his elder brother Tie Bao were both advanced, and contemporaries likened them to two earlier pairs of brothers: Song Jiao and Song Qi, and Su Shi and Su Zhe.
units.literal: Emperor Gaozong personally examined the Banner Hanlin and Household of the Heir Apparent; he and his elder brother Tie Bao were both promoted, and at the time they were compared to Song Jiao and Song Qi, and to Su Shi and Su Zhe.

units.zh: 官至兵部侍郎，究心兵家言。
units.en: He rose to vice minister of war and devoted himself to the art of war.
units.literal: He rose to vice minister of war and devoted himself to military writings.

units.zh: 川、楚教匪起，嘗原自效行間。
units.en: When sectarian rebels broke out in Sichuan and Hubei, he once volunteered for active service.
units.literal: When sectarian rebels rose in Sichuan and Hubei, he once volunteered to serve in the field.

units.zh: 會上欲用為巡撫，為和珅所阻，鬱鬱卒，年甫四十。
units.en: The emperor was about to appoint him governor when Heshen blocked the move. He died in low spirits at barely forty.
units.literal: Just then the emperor wished to appoint him governor, but Heshen obstructed it; he died in dejection at barely forty.

units.zh: 和瑛，原名和寧，避宣宗諱改，字太葊，額勒德特氏，蒙古鑲黃旗人。
units.en: He Ying, originally He Ning, changed his name to avoid the taboo of Emperor Xuanzong. His courtesy name was Taian; he came from the Erlet clan and was a Mongol of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
units.literal: He Ying, originally named He Ning, changed his name to avoid the taboo of Emperor Xuanzong; courtesy name Taian; of the Erlet clan; a Mongol of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

units.zh: 乾隆三十六年進士，授戶部主事，歷員外郎。
units.en: He took his jinshi degree in 1771, entered the Ministry of Revenue as a principal secretary, and rose to vice director.
units.literal: Jinshi in the thirty-sixth year of Qianlong; appointed principal secretary in the Ministry of Revenue and rose through vice director.

units.zh: 出為安徽太平知府，調潁州。
units.en: He was posted prefect of Taiping in Anhui and then transferred to Yingzhou.
units.literal: He went out as prefect of Taiping in Anhui and was transferred to Yingzhou.

units.zh: 五十二年，擢廬鳳道，歷四川按察使，安徽、四川、陝西布政使。
units.en: In 1787 he became intendant of Luzhou and Fengyang, then served as provincial judicial commissioner of Sichuan and as provincial treasurer of Anhui, Sichuan, and Shaanxi in turn.
units.literal: In the fifty-second year he was promoted intendant of Luzhou and Fengyang, and successively served as provincial judicial commissioner of Sichuan and as provincial treasurer of Anhui, Sichuan, and Shaanxi.

units.zh: 五十八年，予副都統銜，充西藏辦事大臣。
units.en: In 1793 he was granted deputy lieutenant-general rank and appointed commissioner in Tibet.
units.literal: In the fifty-eighth year he was given the rank of deputy lieutenant-general and appointed commissioner in Tibet.

units.zh: 尋授內閣學士，仍留藏辦事。
units.en: He was soon made academician of the Grand Secretariat but continued to serve in Tibet.
units.literal: Soon he was appointed grand secretary but remained in Tibet on duty.

units.zh: 和瑛在藏八年，著西藏賦，博採地形、民俗、物產，自為之注。
units.en: He Ying spent eight years in Tibet and wrote the Rhapsody on Tibet, drawing widely on topography, customs, and local products, which he annotated himself.
units.literal: He Ying spent eight years in Tibet and wrote the Xizang Fu, broadly collecting topography, customs, and products, and wrote his own commentary.

units.zh: 嘉慶五年，召為理籓院侍郎，歷工部、戶部，出為山東巡撫。
units.en: In 1800 he was recalled as vice minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, served in the ministries of works and revenue, and was posted governor of Shandong.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Jiaqing he was recalled as vice minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, passed through the ministries of works and revenue, and went out as governor of Shandong.

units.zh: 七年，金鄉皁役之孫張敬禮冒考被控，知縣汪廷楷置不問，學政劉鳳誥以聞，下和瑛提鞫，誤聽濟南知府德生言誣斷，為給事中汪鏞所糾。
units.en: In 1802 Zhang Jingli, grandson of a district runner at Jinxian, was accused of impersonating a candidate in the examinations. Magistrate Wang Tingkai ignored the charge until Education Commissioner Liu Fenggao reported it. The case was referred to He Ying, who wrongly credited Jinan Prefect Desheng and rendered a false judgment, and Censor Wang Yong impeached him.
units.literal: In the seventh year Zhang Jingli, grandson of a runner at Jinxian, was accused of impersonation in the examinations; Magistrate Wang Tingkai ignored it; Provincial Education Commissioner Liu Fenggao reported it; the case was sent down to He Ying for trial; he wrongly heard the words of Jinan Prefect Desheng and rendered a false judgment, and was impeached by Censor Wang Yong.

units.zh: 上以和瑛日事文墨，廢弛政務，即解職，命鏞從侍郎祖之望往按，得實，褫和瑛職，又以匿蝗災事覺，譴戍烏魯木齊。
units.en: The emperor judged that He Ying spent his days on literary pursuits and neglected government, removed him at once, and sent Wang Yong with Vice Minister Zu Zhiwang to investigate. The facts were proved, He Ying was stripped of office, and when a concealed locust disaster also came to light he was sent into exile at Urumqi.
units.literal: The emperor, considering that He Ying daily occupied himself with literary matters and neglected administration, immediately removed him from office and ordered Yong to go with Vice Minister Zu Zhiwang to investigate; the facts were established, He Ying was stripped of office, and when concealment of a locust disaster also came to light he was condemned to exile in Urumqi.

units.zh: 尋予藍翎侍衛，充葉爾羌幫辦大臣，調喀什噶爾參贊大臣。
units.en: He was soon made a blue-lance bodyguard, served as assistant commissioner at Yarkand, and was transferred to assistant commissioner at Kashgar.
units.literal: Soon he was given the rank of blue-lance bodyguard, served as assistant commissioner at Yarkand, and was transferred to assistant commissioner at Kashgar.

units.zh: 九年，授理籓院侍郎，仍留邊任。
units.en: In 1804 he was made vice minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs while remaining on frontier duty.
units.literal: In the ninth year he was appointed vice minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs but still remained on frontier duty.

units.zh: 疏言：「喀什噶爾、英吉沙爾倉儲足供軍食，請減運伊犁布疋，改徵雜糧四千石，減價出糶，且請嗣後折收制錢，以免運費。」
units.en: He memorialized: 'Granaries at Kashgar and Yengisar hold enough for army rations. I ask that cloth shipments to Ili be reduced, that four thousand shi of miscellaneous grain be levied instead, that grain be sold at reduced prices, and that payments hereafter be taken in standard cash to save transport costs.'
units.literal: He memorialized: 'The granaries of Kashgar and Yengisar are sufficient for army provisions; it is requested to reduce transport of cloth to Ili, collect four thousand shi of miscellaneous grain instead, sell grain at reduced price, and hereafter collect in standard cash to avoid transport costs.'

units.zh: 允之。
units.en: The request was approved.
units.literal: This was approved.

units.zh: 劾喀喇沙爾歷任辦事大臣私以庫款貸與軍民，及土爾扈特、回子取息錢入己，降革治罪有差。
units.en: He impeached successive commissioners at Karashahr for lending treasury funds privately to soldiers and civilians and for Torghuts and Muslims who pocketed interest; offenders were demoted, dismissed, or punished according to their guilt.
units.literal: He impeached successive commissioners at Karashahr for privately lending treasury funds to soldiers and civilians, and for Torghut and Muslim persons taking interest for themselves; demotions, dismissals, and punishments were meted out according to degree.

units.zh: 十一年，召還京為吏部侍郎，調倉場。
units.en: In 1806 he was recalled to Beijing as vice minister of personnel and transferred to the capital granaries.
units.literal: In the eleventh year he was recalled to the capital as vice minister of personnel and transferred to the granaries.

units.zh: 未幾，復出為烏魯木齊都統。
units.en: Before long he was again posted lieutenant-general of Urumqi.
units.literal: Before long he again went out as lieutenant-general of Urumqi.

units.zh: 十三年，塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣愛星阿欲調瑪納斯戍兵四百人番上屯田，和瑛謂瑪納斯處極邊，戍兵專事操防，不諳耕作，諮駁以聞，上韙之。
units.en: In 1808 Assistant Commissioner Aisingga of Tarbagatai proposed rotating four hundred Manas garrison troops into field labor. He Ying argued that Manas lay on the outermost frontier, that garrison troops were trained for defense rather than farming, and memorialized a rebuttal, which the emperor upheld.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year Assistant Commissioner Aisingga of Tarbagatai wished to rotate four hundred garrison troops at Manas to field labor in turn; He Ying said Manas was at the extreme frontier, garrison troops were devoted to drill and defense and were unskilled in farming; he consulted and memorialized a rebuttal, and the emperor approved.

units.zh: 十四年，授陝甘總督。
units.en: In 1809 he was appointed governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year he was appointed governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu.

units.zh: 坐前在倉場失察盜米，降大理寺少卿。
units.en: Blamed for failing to detect grain theft while in charge of the granaries, he was demoted to vice president of the Court of Judicial Review.
units.literal: Because of failure to detect grain theft while at the granaries, he was demoted to vice president of the Court of Judicial Review.

units.zh: 十六年，遷盛京刑部侍郎。
units.en: In 1811 he was transferred to vice minister of punishments for Mukden.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year he was transferred to vice minister of punishments for Mukden.

units.zh: 復州、寧海、岫岩飢，將軍觀明以匿災罷免，授和瑛為將軍，廉得邊門章京塔清阿等承觀明意，諱災不報，降革有差。
units.en: Famine struck Fuzhou, Ninghai, and Xiuyan. General Guan Ming was dismissed for concealing the disaster, and He Ying was appointed in his place. He found that frontier secretary Ta Qing'a and others, following Guan Ming's lead, had hidden the famine from report; they were demoted or dismissed according to their guilt.
units.literal: Fuzhou, Ninghai, and Xiuyan suffered famine; General Guan Ming was dismissed for concealing the disaster; He Ying was appointed general and found that frontier gate secretary Ta Qing'a and others, following Guan Ming's intent, had concealed the disaster and not reported it; demotions and dismissals were meted out according to degree.

units.zh: 尋以誤捕屯民張建謨為盜，鍛鍊成獄，刑部覆訊雪其冤，議革和瑛職，詔寬之，留任。
units.en: Soon afterward he wrongly arrested colonist Zhang Jianmo as a bandit and fabricated a case against him. The Ministry of Punishments on review cleared Zhang's name. Although dismissal was proposed, the emperor showed leniency and kept He Ying in office.
units.literal: Soon, for wrongly arresting colonist Zhang Jianmo as a bandit and forging a case, the Ministry of Punishments on re-examination cleared his innocence; it was proposed to strip He Ying of office, but an edict showed leniency and he was retained.

units.zh: 調熱河都統，未上，召為禮部尚書，調兵部。
units.en: He was transferred to lieutenant-general of Rehe but had not taken up the post when he was recalled as minister of rites and moved to head the Ministry of War.
units.literal: He was transferred to lieutenant-general of Rehe but had not taken up the post when he was recalled as minister of rites and transferred to the Ministry of War.

units.zh: 坐失察盛京宗室裕瑞強娶有夫民婦為妾，降盛京副都統，遷熱河都統。
units.en: Blamed for failing to prevent Bannerman Yurui of Mukden from forcibly taking a married commoner woman as concubine, he was demoted to deputy lieutenant-general of Mukden and transferred to lieutenant-general of Rehe.
units.literal: For failure to supervise when Mukden Bannerman Yurui forcibly took a married commoner woman as concubine, he was demoted to deputy lieutenant-general of Mukden and transferred to lieutenant-general of Rehe.

units.zh: 二十一年，授工部尚書。
units.en: In 1816 he was appointed minister of works.
units.literal: In the twenty-first year he was appointed minister of works.

units.zh: 命赴甘肅按倉庫虧缺，得總督先福徇庇及貪縱狀，治如律。
units.en: He was sent to Gansu to investigate granary shortfalls, exposed Governor Xian Fu's shielding of offenders and indulgence of corruption, and punished the guilty according to law.
units.literal: He was ordered to go to Gansu to investigate granary shortfalls, found that Governor Xian Fu had shielded offenders and indulged corruption, and punished them according to law.

units.zh: 二十二年，調兵部，加太子少保，歷禮部、兵部。
units.en: In 1817 he was transferred to the Ministry of War, made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and served in turn as minister of rites and of war.
units.literal: In the twenty-second year he was transferred to the Ministry of War, given the title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and passed through the ministries of rites and war.

units.zh: 二十三年，授軍機大臣、領侍衛內大臣，充上書房總諳達、文穎館總裁。
units.en: In 1818 he joined the Grand Council and became chief commandant of the Imperial Bodyguard, while serving as chief instructor of the Southern Study and chief compiler of the Wenyin Hall.
units.literal: In the twenty-third year he was appointed Grand Councilor and chief commandant of the Imperial Bodyguard, and served as chief instructor of the Southern Study and chief compiler of the Wenyin Hall.

units.zh: 逾一歲，調刑部，罷內直。
units.en: A little over a year later he was moved to the Ministry of Punishments and relieved of inner-court service.
units.literal: After more than a year he was transferred to the Ministry of Punishments and removed from inner-court duty.

units.zh: 道光元年，卒，贈太子太保，諡簡勤。
units.en: He died in 1821 and was posthumously made Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent with the posthumous name Jianqin.
units.literal: In the first year of Daoguang he died; he was posthumously given the title Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and the posthumous name Jianqin.

units.zh: 和瑛嫺習掌故，優於文學，著書多不傳。
units.en: He Ying was steeped in institutional precedent and excelled in letters, though many of his books have not survived.
units.literal: He Ying was well versed in institutional precedents and excelled in letters; many of his books have not been transmitted.

units.zh: 久任邊職，有惠政。
units.en: His long service on the frontier won him a reputation for benevolent rule.
units.literal: He long held frontier posts and had benevolent administration.

units.zh: 後其子璧昌治回疆，回部猶歸心焉。
units.en: Later his son Bichang governed the Muslim borderlands, and the frontier peoples still looked to the family with loyalty.
units.literal: Later his son Bichang governed the Muslim borderlands, and the Muslim peoples still gave him their hearts.

units.zh: 璧昌自有傳。
units.en: Bichang has a separate biography.
units.literal: Bichang has his own biography.

units.zh: 覺羅桂芳，字香東，隸鑲藍旗，總督圖思德孫。
units.en: Jueluo Guifang, whose courtesy name was Xiangdong, belonged to the Bordered Blue Banner and was a grandson of Governor Tusi De.
units.literal: Jueluo Guifang, courtesy name Xiangdong, enrolled in the Bordered Blue Banner, grandson of Governor Tusi De.

units.zh: 嘉慶四年進士，選庶吉士，授檢討。
units.en: He took his jinshi degree in 1799, entered the Hanlin as a probationer academician, and was appointed reviser.
units.literal: Jinshi in the fourth year of Jiaqing, selected as bachelor of the Hanlin Academy, appointed reviser.

units.zh: 嘗召對，仁宗曰：「奇才也！」
units.en: On one audience with the emperor, Emperor Renzong declared: 'A rare talent!'
units.literal: Once summoned for audience, Emperor Renzong said: 'A rare talent!'

units.zh: 不數年，累擢內閣學士。
units.en: Within a few years he rose step by step to academician of the Grand Secretariat.
units.literal: Within a few years he was repeatedly promoted to grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat.

units.zh: 十一年，入直上書房，遷禮部侍郎，歷吏部、戶部侍郎，兼副都統、總管內務府大臣、翰林院掌院學士。
units.en: In 1806 he joined the Southern Study, became vice minister of rites, then served as vice minister of personnel and of revenue while concurrently holding posts as deputy lieutenant-general, superintendent of the Imperial Household, and chancellor of the Hanlin.
units.literal: In the eleventh year he entered the Southern Study, was transferred to vice minister of rites, passed through vice ministries of personnel and revenue, and concurrently held the posts of deputy lieutenant-general, superintendent of the Imperial Household Department, and chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.

units.zh: 迭典順天、江南鄉試，兼直南書房。
units.en: He presided in turn over the Shuntian and Jiangnan provincial examinations and also served in the Southern Study.
units.literal: He successively presided over the Shuntian and Jiangnan provincial examinations and concurrently served in the Southern Study.

units.zh: 桂芳家素貧，有門生餽納，曰：「執贄禮甚古。
units.en: Guifang's family had long been poor. When a student offered him a gift, he said: 'The ritual of presenting tribute is indeed ancient.
units.literal: Guifang's family had long been poor; a student presented a gift, and he said: 'The ritual of presenting tribute is very ancient.

units.zh: 某忝佐司農，俸入粗給，無藉乎此。」
units.en: I am unworthy to serve in the Ministry of Revenue; my salary is enough, and I have no need of this.'
units.literal: I am unworthy to assist the Ministry of Revenue; my salary roughly suffices, and I have no need of this.'

units.zh: 封還之。
units.en: He sealed the gift and returned it.
units.literal: He sealed it and returned it.

units.zh: 大學士祿康輿夫聚博，命偕侍郎英和按治，無所徇。
units.en: When Grand Secretary Lu Kang's servants were found gambling, Guifang was ordered to investigate with Vice Minister Ying He and showed no partiality.
units.literal: Grand Secretary Lu Kang's servants gathered to gamble; he was ordered to investigate together with Vice Minister Ying He, and showed no partiality.

units.zh: 上嘉其不避嫌怨。
units.en: The emperor commended him for not shirking ill will or resentment.
units.literal: The emperor praised him for not avoiding enmity and resentment.

units.zh: 十八年，教匪林清逆黨闌入禁城，桂芳方直內廷，偕諸王大臣率兵殲捕，敘勞，加二級。
units.en: In 1813 Lin Qing's rebel sect broke into the Forbidden City while Guifang was on duty in the inner court. He joined princes and grand ministers in leading troops to crush the intruders and was rewarded with two steps of promotion.
units.literal: In the eighteenth year the rebel party of the sectarian Lin Qing broke into the Forbidden City; Guifang was then on duty in the inner court and, together with princes and grand ministers, led troops to exterminate and capture them; for merit he was given two steps of promotion.

units.zh: 上遇變修省，訓誡臣工，頒御製文七篇，示內廷諸臣，命各抒所見，書以進禦。
units.en: After the crisis the emperor turned to self-examination, admonished the bureaucracy, issued seven imperial essays, showed them to inner-court officials, and ordered each to submit written views to the throne.
units.literal: After the crisis the emperor cultivated self-examination, admonished his ministers, issued seven imperial compositions, showed them to inner-court officials, and ordered each to express his views in writing for presentation to the throne.

units.zh: 桂芳書罪己詔后曰：「皇上臨御以來，承列聖深仁厚澤，日以愛民為政，四海之內，莫不聞睹。
units.en: Guifang wrote after the emperor's self-reproach edict: 'Since Your Majesty came to the throne, inheriting the deep benevolence of successive sage rulers, you have governed daily with love for the people, and all within the four seas have witnessed it.
units.literal: Guifang wrote after the self-reproach edict: 'Since Your Majesty ascended the throne, inheriting the deep benevolence and thick grace of successive sages, you have daily governed with love for the people; within the four seas none has failed to hear and see this.

units.zh: 今茲事變，豈不怪異？
units.en: That such an incident should occur—is it not strange?
units.literal: Now this incident—is it not strange?

units.zh: 而臣竊以為此未足為聖德之累。
units.en: Yet I venture to think this is not enough to diminish Your Majesty's sagely virtue.
units.literal: Yet your servant privately thinks this is not enough to burden sagely virtue.

units.zh: 昔孔子論仁至於濟眾，論敬至於安百姓，皆曰：'堯、舜其猶病諸。
units.en: Confucius, in speaking of benevolence as far as benefiting the multitude and of reverence as far as securing the people, said of each: 'Even Yao and Shun would still have found it difficult.'
units.literal: Formerly Confucius, in discussing benevolence up to benefiting the multitude and respect up to securing the people, said of both: 'Even Yao and Shun would still have found it difficult.'

units.zh: '豈真以堯、舜之聖為未至哉？
units.en: Did he truly mean that Yao and Shun had not yet attained sagehood?
units.literal: Did he truly regard the sagehood of Yao and Shun as not yet attained?

units.zh: 夫天下之大，萬民之眾，而決其無一夫之梗者，蓋自古其難之。
units.en: In a realm so vast and a populace so numerous, to ensure that not a single man is recalcitrant has been difficult since antiquity.
units.literal: For all the vastness of the realm and the multitude of the people, to decide that not a single man is recalcitrant has from antiquity been difficult.

units.zh: 然而揆之人事，則實有未盡者。
units.en: Yet measured by human affairs, there were indeed things left undone.
units.literal: Yet measured by human affairs, there truly were things not fully done.

units.zh: 夫林清先以習教被系，既釋歸，轉益煽亂。
units.en: Lin Qing was first arrested for sect activity, and after his release he only fomented rebellion the more.
units.literal: Lin Qing was first arrested for practicing sect teachings; after release he returned home and only fomented rebellion the more.

units.zh: 數年之間，往來糾結於曹、衛、齊、魯之間，其黨至數千人。
units.en: Within a few years he traveled through Cao, Wei, Qi, and Lu organizing his following, which grew to several thousand.
units.literal: Within a few years he traveled back and forth organizing conspiracies among Cao, Wei, Qi, and Lu; his party reached several thousand.

units.zh: 閹寺職官，竟有與其謀者，而未事之先，曾無一人抉發，是吏無政也。
units.en: Eunuchs and officials even joined his plot, yet before the attack not one person exposed it—this shows that official administration had failed.
units.literal: Eunuchs and officials actually joined in his plot, yet before the affair not one person exposed it—this shows that officials had no government.

units.zh: 藏利刃，懷白幟，度越門關，飲於都市，無诇而知者，是邏者、門者無禁也。
units.en: They hid blades, carried white banners, passed gate after gate, and drank in the markets without anyone detecting them—this shows that patrolmen and gatekeepers enforced no ban.
units.literal: They hid sharp blades, carried white banners, crossed gate after gate, drank in the marketplaces, and none who inquired knew—this shows that patrolmen and gatekeepers had no prohibition.

units.zh: 禁兵千計，賊不及百，闔門而擊之，俄頃可盡，乃兩日一夜始悉擒戮，是軍無律也。
units.en: Palace guards numbered in the thousands while the rebels were fewer than a hundred; with the gates closed they could have been destroyed in moments, yet it took two days and a night to capture and kill them all—this shows that the army had no discipline.
units.literal: Palace guards numbered in the thousands, rebels not a hundred; closing the gates and striking them could have exterminated them in a moment, yet only after two days and one night were all captured and killed—this shows that the army had no discipline.

units.zh: 夫吏惰卒驕，文武並弛，而法制禁令為虛器，則事之可憂，豈獨在賊？
units.en: When officials grow slack, soldiers arrogant, civil and military discipline alike relax, and laws become empty forms, the danger lies not only in the rebels themselves?
units.literal: When officials are slack and soldiers arrogant, civil and military alike are lax, and laws and prohibitions become empty vessels, then what is to be feared in the affair lies not only in the rebels?

units.zh: 我皇上觀微知著，洞悉天下之故，詔曰'方今大弊在因循怠玩'，至哉言乎！
units.en: Your Majesty observes the subtle and knows the manifest and has thoroughly grasped the state of the realm. The edict declaring that 'the great evil of the age lies in routine and slack indulgence' is words of the highest wisdom!
units.literal: Our emperor observes the subtle and knows the manifest, thoroughly understands the reasons of all under heaven, and in an edict said: 'At present the great evil lies in routine and slack indulgence'—how excellent a saying!

units.zh: 臣敬繹之，蓋因循怠玩，亦有所由。
units.en: I respectfully interpret this: routine and slack indulgence also have their causes.
units.literal: Your servant respectfully interprets this: routine and slack indulgence also have their causes.

units.zh: 無才與識，則有因循而已；
units.en: Without talent and judgment, there is only routine;
units.literal: Without talent and knowledge, there is only routine;

units.zh: 無志與氣，則有怠玩而已。
units.en: without will and resolve, there is only slack indulgence.
units.literal: without will and spirit, there is only slack indulgence.

units.zh: 是故得人而任之，則因循怠玩之習不患不除。
units.en: Therefore, if the right men are found and entrusted with office, the habits of routine and slack indulgence can surely be uprooted.
units.literal: Therefore if the right men are obtained and entrusted, the habits of routine and slack indulgence need not be feared as impossible to remove.

units.zh: 儻非其人，微獨不能除其習而已；
units.en: If the wrong men are chosen, not only will those habits remain;
units.literal: If they are not the right men, not only can the habits not be removed;

units.zh: 就令除之，不因循而且為煩苛，不怠玩而且為躁競，其無裨於治則均耳。
units.en: even if one tries to remove them, the result will be not routine but vexatious harshness, not slackness but rash contention—equally useless for good government.
units.literal: even if one removes them, one will not be routine but will become vexatiously harsh, not slack but will become rash and contentious—the harm to good government is the same.

units.zh: 是在皇上詢事考言，循名責實，器使之以奏其能，專任之以收其效，因小失而崇丕業，在陛下一旋轉間耳。」
units.en: The remedy lies in Your Majesty inquiring into affairs and testing words, matching names to realities, employing each man according to his capacity, entrusting him fully to secure results, and turning a small setback into a great achievement—all within a single turn of Your Majesty's will.'
units.literal: This lies in Your Majesty inquiring into affairs and examining words, matching names to realities, employing men according to their capacity so they may display their ability, entrusting them fully so as to gather their effect, and through a small loss exalting a great enterprise—all within a single turn of Your Majesty.'

units.zh: 書行實政論后曰：「實心者何？
units.en: He wrote after the essay on practicing real government: 'What is a sincere heart?
units.literal: He wrote after the essay on practicing real government: 'What is a sincere heart?

units.zh: 忠是也。
units.en: Loyalty.
units.literal: Loyalty is it.

units.zh: 忠者一於為國，而不亟亟於求上之知。
units.en: Loyalty means single-minded service to the state, not urgent pursuit of the ruler's notice.
units.literal: Loyalty is singleness in serving the state and not urgently seeking the ruler's notice.

units.zh: 其所以急於公者如急於己，一政而便於民，其行之而恐不及也；
units.en: He is as urgent for the public good as for himself; when a policy benefits the people, he implements it fearing he may be too late;
units.literal: What he is urgent about for the public is as what he is urgent about for himself; one policy that benefits the people he carries out fearing it may not be soon enough;

units.zh: 一政而不便於民，其去之恐不速也。
units.en: when a policy harms the people, he removes it fearing he may not act swiftly enough.
units.literal: one policy that does not benefit the people he removes fearing it may not be swift enough.

units.zh: 不以避疑謗而易其是非之公，不以處疏逖而違其夙夜之志。
units.en: He does not alter right and wrong to avoid suspicion and slander, nor abandon his tireless resolve because he stands far from power.
units.literal: He does not, to avoid suspicion and slander, alter the fairness of right and wrong; he does not, because he stands remote, violate his early-and-late resolve.

units.zh: 故其於政也，籌之至審，而不為旦夕之謀；
units.en: In government he plans with utmost care and does not scheme for short-term gain;
units.literal: Therefore in government he plans with utmost care and does not scheme for a morning and an evening;

units.zh: 行之務當，而不揣詔旨之合；
units.en: he carries out policy as it ought to be done and does not guess whether it matches the imperial edict;
units.literal: he carries out affairs with due fitness and does not guess whether they match the imperial edict;

units.zh: 惟力是視，不必其事之諒於人；
units.en: he exerts all his strength and does not require that others understand his actions;
units.literal: he looks only to exerting strength and does not require that the affair be understood by others;

units.zh: 惟善之從，不必其謀之出於己。
units.en: he follows only what is good and does not require that the plan be his own.
units.literal: he follows only what is good and does not require that the plan come from himself.

units.zh: 若是者謂之實政。
units.en: Such conduct is called real government.
units.literal: One such as this is called real government.

units.zh: 夫為臣之道，疇不當忠，然而忠之實蓋如此。
units.en: Who among ministers ought not to be loyal? Yet the reality of loyalty is truly thus.
units.literal: In the way of being a minister, who ought not to be loyal? Yet the reality of loyalty is truly thus.

units.zh: 非然者，初無寸勞，而已為見功之地；
units.en: Otherwise, without the slightest labor he already prepares a place to display achievement;
units.literal: If not so, without a hair's worth of labor he already makes a place to show achievement;

units.zh: 未必加譴，而已存巧避之心。
units.en: before any punishment is even threatened he already harbors a crafty heart of evasion.
units.literal: before punishment is necessarily increased he already harbors a crafty heart of avoidance.

units.zh: 取容於唯諾，而不以國事為憂；
units.en: He wins favor through compliant assent and does not worry over state affairs;
units.literal: he gains acceptance through yes-men assent and does not take state affairs as a worry;

units.zh: 快意於愛憎，而不以人才為惜。
units.en: he indulges personal likes and dislikes and does not cherish talent.
units.literal: he gratifies himself in likes and dislikes and does not cherish talent.

units.zh: 如斯人者，雖我皇上日討而訓之，尚望其能行實政乎？
units.en: Men such as these—even if Your Majesty reproved and instructed them daily—could one still hope they would practice real government?
units.literal: Men such as this—even if our emperor daily reproved and instructed them—could one still hope they would practice real government?

units.zh: 夫政者，上所以治天下之具。
units.en: Government is the instrument by which the ruler governs the realm.
units.literal: Government is the instrument by which the ruler governs all under heaven.

units.zh: 然而行之以實，乃能有功，不則文具而已。
units.en: Only if carried out in earnest can it achieve results; otherwise it is mere paperwork.
units.literal: Yet only if carried out in reality can it have achievement; otherwise it is mere paperwork.

units.zh: 官無實政，民乃不治，非細故也。
units.en: When officials practice no real government, the people cannot be well governed—this is no small matter.
units.literal: When officials have no real government, the people are not well governed—this is no small matter.

units.zh: 皇上震動恪恭，求賢納諫，敕中外諸臣，改慮易志。
units.en: The emperor was shaken into reverent self-examination, sought the worthy and accepted remonstrance, and charged officials throughout the empire to change their minds and renew their resolve.
units.literal: The emperor was shaken and reverently respectful, sought the worthy and accepted remonstrance, and charged officials within and without to change their thoughts and renew their wills.

units.zh: 稍有人心者，疇敢不勉；
units.en: Those who retain the slightest conscience—who would dare not exert themselves?
units.literal: Those who retain the slightest human heart—who would dare not exert themselves?

units.zh: 而臣所欲言者，則又在陛下之心矣。
units.en: Yet what I wish to say lies above all in Your Majesty's own heart.
units.literal: Yet what your servant wishes to speak lies again in Your Majesty's heart.

units.zh: 臣昨歲恭錄乾隆朝臣孫嘉淦三習一弊疏於御製養心殿記冊末，伏原萬幾之暇，時賜觀覽。
units.en: Last year I respectfully copied at the end of the imperial Yangxin Hall notebook the memorial of Qianlong minister Sun Jiagan on the Three Habits and One Evil, and humbly pray that in leisure from the myriad affairs of state Your Majesty may read it from time to time.
units.literal: Last year your servant respectfully copied at the end of the imperially composed Yangxin Hall notebook the memorial of Qianlong minister Sun Jiagan on the Three Habits and One Evil, and humbly pray that in leisure from the myriad affairs Your Majesty may from time to time grant it perusal.

units.zh: 用其說以考諸臣之政，因以識諸臣之心，則賢才不患其不思奮，庶績不患其不咸熙。
units.en: Using his doctrine to test ministers' conduct and thereby discern their hearts, worthy talent will not fail to strive, and the myriad tasks of state will flourish.
units.literal: Using his doctrine to examine the government of various ministers, and thereby to know their hearts, then worthy talent need not be feared as unwilling to strive, and the myriad tasks need not be feared as not all flourishing.

units.zh: 較臣管蠡之見，似更有助於高深焉。」
units.en: Compared with my narrow view, this would seem more helpful to Your Majesty's lofty wisdom.'
units.literal: Compared with your servant's tube-and-gourd view, this would seem more helpful to Your Majesty's lofty wisdom.'

units.zh: 又論致變之源，由於民窮，民窮由於幣輕，幣輕則國與民交病。
units.en: He also argued that the upheaval sprang from popular poverty, that poverty sprang from debased currency, and that debased currency afflicted both state and people alike.
units.literal: He also discussed the source of the upheaval: it lay in the people's poverty; the people's poverty lay in the lightness of currency; when currency is light, state and people alike suffer.

units.zh: 論刑用重典而不得其平，則不能格姦定亂。
units.en: He argued that when severe punishments are applied without fairness, crime cannot be checked nor disorder settled.
units.literal: He discussed that when punishments use severe statutes without obtaining fairness, one cannot reform the wicked and settle disorder.

units.zh: 論民惑邪教，由士大夫好言因果利益有以導之。
units.en: He argued that popular delusion by heterodox sects was led on by scholar-officials who delighted in preaching karma and profit.
units.literal: He discussed that when the people are deluded by heterodox sects, it is because scholar-officials delight in speaking of karmic cause and benefit and thereby lead them.

units.zh: 因事納規，所言多切中時弊。
units.en: Seizing occasions to remonstrate, his words mostly struck at the evils of the age.
units.literal: Seizing occasions to offer remonstrance, what he said mostly struck the evils of the time.

units.zh: 於是復條陳時事，或見之，謂其未必盡合上意。
units.en: He then memorialized again on current affairs, and some who saw the drafts said they might not fully accord with the emperor's intent.
units.literal: Thereupon he again set forth current affairs in articles; some who saw them said they might not fully accord with the imperial intent.

units.zh: 桂芳慨然曰：「此何時，尚以迎合為言耶？」
units.en: Guifang said with feeling: 'What time is this, and still you speak of currying favor?'
units.literal: Guifang said with feeling: 'What time is this, and still to speak of currying favor?'

units.zh: 及上，嘉納之，命暫在軍機處學習行走。
units.en: When the memorial was submitted, the emperor praised and accepted it and ordered him to study and serve temporarily in the Grand Council.
units.literal: When submitted, the emperor praised and accepted it and ordered him temporarily to study and serve in the Grand Council.

units.zh: 未幾，授軍機大臣。
units.en: Before long he was made a Grand Councilor.
units.literal: Before long he was appointed Grand Councilor.

units.zh: 十九年，軍事竣，以贊畫功賜桂芳子炳奎七品小京官。
units.en: In 1814, when the military campaign ended, his son Bingkui was granted a seventh-rank junior Beijing secretary for Guifang's planning merit.
units.literal: In the nineteenth year, when military affairs were concluded, for planning merit his son Bingkui was granted a seventh-rank junior Beijing secretary.

units.zh: 尋命往廣西按事，授漕運總督。
units.en: He was soon ordered to Guangxi to investigate affairs and was appointed director-general of grain transport.
units.literal: Soon he was ordered to go to Guangxi to investigate affairs and was appointed director-general of grain transport.

units.zh: 未至廣西，於武昌途次病疫，卒。
units.en: Before he reached Guangxi he fell ill with epidemic disease on the road at Wuchang and died.
units.literal: Before reaching Guangxi, on the road at Wuchang he fell ill with epidemic disease and died.

units.zh: 上以桂芳明慎直爽，方鄉用，至是優詔褒卹，嘆為「良才難得」，贈太子少保，加尚書銜；
units.en: The emperor, who had valued Guifang's clarity, caution, and forthright candor and had been about to employ him in the provinces, now issued a gracious edict of praise and condolence, sighed that "good talent is hard to find," and posthumously made him Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent with ministerial rank;
units.literal: The emperor, considering Guifang clear, cautious, forthright, and open, had just been about to employ him in the provinces; now he issued a gracious edict of praise and condolence, sighed that "good talent is hard to obtain," and posthumously gave him the title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent with ministerial rank;

units.zh: 復以曾授三阿哥讀書，喪至京師，命三阿哥往奠，御製詩悼之，諡文敏。
units.en: because he had once taught the Third Prince, when the funeral reached Beijing the emperor ordered the prince to offer condolences, composed an imperial mourning poem, and gave him the posthumous name Wenmin.
units.literal: also because he had once taught the Third Prince, when the funeral reached the capital he ordered the Third Prince to go and offer condolences, composed an imperial poem in mourning, and gave the posthumous name Wenmin.

units.zh: 著有經進、敬儀堂詩存，才華豐贍，為時所稱。
units.en: His works include presentations to the throne and the Jingyi Studio poetry collection; his rich talent was widely praised in his day.
units.literal: His works include Jingjin and Jingyitang Shicun; his talent was rich and ample and was praised by his age.

units.zh: 論曰：承平既久，八旗人士起甲科、列侍從者，亦多以文字被恩眷。
units.en: The historians say: After long peace, many Banner men who rose through the civil examinations and entered court service also won imperial favor through literary accomplishment.
units.literal: The historians say: Peace had long endured; among Banner people who rose through the civil examinations and entered attendance on the throne, many also received imperial favor through literary accomplishment.

units.zh: 達椿忤權相，晚乃見用，其守正有足稱。
units.en: Da Chun offended the powerful minister and was employed only late in life; his integrity is worthy of praise.
units.literal: Da Chun offended the powerful minister and was employed only late; his uprightness is worthy of praise.

units.zh: 鐵保、和瑛並器識淵雅，述作斐然。
units.en: Tie Bao and He Ying alike possessed deep and elegant judgment, and their writings were splendid.
units.literal: Tie Bao and He Ying alike had deep and elegant capacity and judgment, and their writings were splendid.

units.zh: 桂芳通達政體，建言諤諤，最為一時俊才，年命不永，未竟其用，惜哉！
units.en: Guifang thoroughly understood government, remonstrated with blunt honesty, and stood foremost among the outstanding talents of his age; his life was short and he did not fulfill his promise—alas!
units.literal: Guifang thoroughly understood the body of government, remonstrated with blunt honesty, and was foremost among the outstanding talents of the age; his years were not long and he did not fulfill his use—alas!

units.zh: 尚書敬顯儁曰：「孔子云：『微管仲，吾其被發左衽矣』以此言之，右衽為是。」
units.en: Minister Jing Xianjun said, "Confucius said, 'Were it not for Guan Zhong, we would wear our hair loose and our lapel to the left.' By this reasoning the right lapel is correct."
units.literal: Minister Jing Xianjun said, "Confucius said, 'Were it not for Guan Zhong, we would wear our hair loose and our lapel to the left.' By this reasoning the right lapel is correct."

units.zh: 孔毓璞十月丁丑革。戊寅彭維新署左都御史。十一月庚戌孫嘉淦左都御史。
units.en: On the dingchou day of the tenth month, Kong Yupu was dismissed. On the wuyin day, Peng Weixin served in an acting capacity as Left Censor-in-Chief. On the gengxu day of the eleventh month, Sun Jiagan: Left Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 雍正十三年乙卯
units.en: The thirteenth year of Yongzheng, yimao
units.literal: Yongzheng 13, yimao year

units.zh: 嘉慶初元，再舉千叟宴，朝鮮、安南、暹羅、廓爾喀額爾德尼王吉爾巴納足塔畢噶爾瑪薩九叩，「跪奉大皇帝前：竊小臣聞湖南教匪滋事，致天威震怒，遣兵剿除。
units.en: At the beginning of the Jiaqing reign, the banquet of a thousand elders was held again; Korea, Annam, Siam, and the king of Gorkha, Girbanazutabigarmasa, performed nine kowtows, kneeling to address the Great Emperor: "Your humble subject heard that bandits in Hunan provoked the imperial wrath and troops were dispatched to suppress them.
units.literal: At the beginning of the Jiaqing reign, the banquet of a thousand elders was held again; Korea, Annam, Siam, and the king of Gorkha, Girbanazutabigarmasa, performed nine kowtows, kneeling to address the Great Emperor: "Your humble subject heard that bandits in Hunan provoked the imperial wrath and troops were dispatched to suppress them.

units.zh: 二十一年，英復遣使來貢，執事者告以須行拜跪禮，司當冬等遂稱疾不入覲，帝怒，諭遣歸國，罷筵宴賜物。
units.en: In the twenty-first year, England again sent envoys to present tribute; the officials told them they must perform the kneeling and kowtowing rites; Staunton and others then claimed illness and refused audience; the emperor in anger ordered them sent home and canceled the banquet and gifts.
units.literal: In the twenty-first year, England again sent envoys to present tribute; the officials told them they must perform the kneeling and kowtowing rites; Staunton and others then claimed illness and refused audience; the emperor in anger ordered them sent home and canceled the banquet and gifts.

units.zh: 雲南巡撫初彭齡乞養歸，壯圖疏請留，上不允。
units.en: When Yunnan Governor Chu Pengling asked to retire to care for his parents, Zhuangtu asked that he be kept; the Emperor refused.
units.literal: When Yunnan Governor Chu Pengling begged to retire for his parents' care, Zhuangtu memorialized asking that he be retained; the Emperor did not agree.

units.zh: 伏願陛下哀忠念舊，愛孤恤寡，矜愚嘉善，舍過記功，敦骨肉之情，廣寬仁之路，思堯、舜之風，慕禹、湯之德，克己復禮，以成美化，天下幸甚。」
units.en: I venture to hope Your Majesty will pity the loyal and remember the old, cherish the orphaned and comfort the widowed, pity the foolish and praise the good, pardon faults and record merit, thicken kinship among flesh and bone, broaden the path of generous forbearance, think of the manner of Yao and Shun, admire the virtue of Yu and Tang, restrain yourself and return to ritual to complete a transformation of culture — all under Heaven would be greatly blessed."
units.literal: I venture to hope Your Majesty will pity the loyal and remember the old, cherish the orphaned and comfort the widowed, pity the foolish and praise the good, pardon faults and record merit, thicken kinship among flesh and bone, broaden the path of generous forbearance, think of the manner of Yao and Shun, admire the virtue of Yu and Tang, restrain yourself and return to ritual, to complete a transformation of culture — all under Heaven would be greatly blessed."

units.zh: 厥後定邊將軍兆惠等、定西將軍阿桂等奏凱，高宗均駐蹕黃新莊行宮，築台郊勞，百官咸會。
units.en: Thereafter when Pacification-of-the-Frontier General Zhao Hui and others and Pacification-of-the-West General Agui and others reported victory, the Gaozong each time halted at the Huangxinzhuang traveling palace, built a platform for suburban welcome, and all officials assembled.
units.literal: Thereafter when Pacification-of-the-Frontier General Zhao Hui and others and Pacification-of-the-West General Agui and others reported victory, the Gaozong each time halted at the Huangxinzhuang traveling palace, built a platform for suburban welcome, and all officials assembled.

units.zh: 將軍暨從征大臣、將士皆擐甲胄，跪紅柱外俟駕。
units.en: The general and the expedition ministers and soldiers all donned armor and knelt outside the red posts awaiting the imperial arrival.
units.literal: The general and expedition ministers and soldiers all donned armor and knelt outside the red posts awaiting the imperial arrival.

units.zh: 帝就拜位立，將軍暨群臣班分東西，鴻臚官贊「跪」，則皆跪。
units.en: The emperor took his position at the kneeling place and stood; the general and officials were arranged in ranks east and west; when the Director of Ceremonies intoned "Kneel," all knelt.
units.literal: The emperor took his position at the kneeling place and stood; the general and officials were arranged in ranks east and west; when the Director of Ceremonies intoned "Kneel," all knelt.

units.zh: 帝拜天，三跪九叩，將軍等如之。
units.en: The emperor bowed to Heaven with three kneelings and nine prostrations, and the generals and others did likewise.
units.literal: The emperor bowed to Heaven with three kneelings and nine prostrations, and the generals and others did likewise.

units.zh: 放勛、重華之世，咸無意於受終，當塗、典午之君，雖有心於揖讓，皆以英才處萬乘，高勳御四海，故能大庇黔首，光宅區縣。
units.en: Yao and Shun took the throne without seeking it; the rulers of Wei and Jin, though they spoke of abdication, still set men of rare talent upon the throne and men of towering merit at the helm of the realm—thus they sheltered the people and brought order to the land.
units.literal: In the ages of Fangxun and Chonghua, both were without intent to receive the end; the lords of Dangtu and Dianwu, though they had mind for yielding, all alike placed men of outstanding talent upon the ten-thousand chariots, with high merit steering the four seas—therefore they could greatly shelter the black-haired people and brightly settle the districts and counties.

units.zh: 既而煙雲表色，日月呈瑞，緯聚東井，龍見譙邦，除舊布新，既彰玄象，遷虞事夏，且協謳訟，[2]九域八荒，同布衷款，百神群祀，皆有誠願。
units.en: Then clouds and mist took auspicious hues; sun and moon showed signs; stars clustered at the Eastern Well; a dragon was seen in Qiao. The old order gave way to the new, and Heaven's signs were plain; as in the transfer from Shun to Yu, the people's acclaim agreed. [2] Within the nine provinces and beyond the eight directions, loyal petitions poured in; every spirit and rite was offered in earnest devotion.
units.literal: Thereafter clouds and mist showed color; sun and moon presented omens; constellations gathered at the Eastern Well; a dragon appeared in the Qiao region. Removing the old and spreading the new, the dark signs were already manifest; shifting from Yu and serving Xia, and moreover matching the songs of praise, [2] the nine domains and eight wilds alike spread forth sincere petitions; the hundred spirits and assembled sacrifices all had sincere wish.

units.zh: 梁氏以天祿斯改，期運永終，欽若唐、虞，推其鼎玉，朕東西退讓，拜手陳辭，避舜子於箕山之陽，求支伯於滄洲之野，而公卿敦逼，率土翹惶，天命難稽，遂享嘉祚。
units.en: The House of Liang, its mandate spent, its turn complete—like Tang and Yu they offered up the regalia. We yielded east and west, bowed with joined hands and pleaded our case, hiding like Shun's son on Mount Ji's sunny slope, seeking Zhibo on Cangzhou's wilds—but ministers pressed us and the realm looked up in dread. Heaven's mandate would not wait; thus We received the glorious throne.
units.literal: The House of Liang, its heavenly blessing now changed, its allotted span ended forever—reverently in accord with Tang and Yu, they pushed forth their tripod and jade. We yielded east and west, bowed with joined hands and spoke our plea, avoiding Shun's son on the sunny slope of Mount Ji, seeking Zhibo on the wilds of Cangzhou—but the dukes and ministers pressed urgently; the whole land looked up in alarm. Heaven's mandate could not be delayed; thus We received the fine fortune.

units.zh: 四年，高宗崩，大學士和珅得罪，仁宗以福長安阿附，逮下獄，奪爵，籍其家。
units.en: In 1799, after Qianlong's death, Heshen fell; Jiaqing arrested Fuchang'an for siding with Heshen, stripped his rank, and seized his property.
units.literal: In the fourth year, when the Gaozong Emperor died, Grand Secretary Heshen was condemned; the Renzong Emperor, holding that Fuchang'an had fawned on Heshen, had him arrested, stripped of rank, and his property confiscated.

units.zh: 諸大臣議用朋黨律坐立斬，上命改監候，而賜和珅死，使監福長安詣和珅死所跪視。
units.en: Ministers proposed decapitation under the faction law; the emperor commuted it to imprisonment, executed Heshen, and made Fuchang'an watch.
units.literal: The ministers proposed sentencing by the statute on faction, which meant immediate decapitation; the emperor ordered imprisonment awaiting execution instead, and while granting Heshen death ordered Fuchang'an brought to kneel where Heshen died and watch.

units.zh: 嘉祐四年十月，仁宗親 詣太廟行祫享禮，以宰臣富弼為祫享大禮使，韓琦為禮儀使，樞密使宋庠為儀仗使，參知政事曾公亮為橋道頓遞使，樞密副使程戡為鹵簿使。
units.en: In the tenth month of the fourth year of Jiayou, Emperor Renzong went in person to the Imperial Ancestral Temple to perform the xiá merging sacrifice. Chief Councilor Fu Bi served as Grandee of the Xiá Rite; Han Qi as Master of Ceremonies; Privy Council Commissioner Song Xiang as Master of Insignia; Vice Grand Councilor Zeng Gongliang as Master of Bridge Roads and Relay Arrangements; and Vice Privy Council Commissioner Cheng Kan as Master of the Imperial Guard.
units.literal: In the tenth month of the fourth year of Jiayou, Emperor Renzong personally went to the Imperial Ancestral Temple to perform the xiá offering. Fu Bi, a chief councilor, was appointed Grandee of the Xiá Offering; Han Qi, Master of Ceremonies; Song Xiang, Commissioner of the Privy Council, Master of Insignia; Zeng Gongliang, Vice Grand Councilor, Master of Bridge Roads and Relay Stations; and Cheng Kan, Vice Commissioner of the Privy Council, Master of the Imperial Guard.

units.en: Twenty-fifth year of Jiaqing, 1820, gengchen
units.literal: Twenty-fifth year of Jiaqing, gengchen

units.zh: 五年，允英和之請，以八旗圈馬四百匹，改撥巡捕營，令滿洲、蒙古馬兵演習騎射，春秋二季，步軍統領會同左右翼總兵簡閱，三年後親臨大閱，八年，令那彥成等回疆增設防兵，籌給餉糈，議定操兵章程，並於喀什噶爾防兵內，抽練二千名，伊犁滿兵亦勤習騎射，由參贊大臣及總兵督操。
units.en: In year 5 Yinghe's request was granted: four hundred banner pasture horses were reassigned to the patrol brigade for Manchu and Mongol cavalry archery, inspected each spring and autumn by the foot-soldiers commandant with the wing regional commanders; after three years the emperor would personally hold a grand review. In year 8 Nayancheng and others expanded Muslim-frontier garrisons, funded them, set drill rules, picked two thousand Kashgar men to train, and ordered diligent archery drill for Ili Manchu under the resident and regional commander.
units.literal: In the fifth year, Yinghe's request was granted: four hundred horses from the Eight Banners' pastures were reassigned to the Patrol Brigade; Manchu and Mongol cavalry were ordered to practice mounted archery; in spring and autumn the foot-soldiers commandant together with left- and right-wing regional commanders conducted inspection; three years later the emperor would personally attend a grand inspection. In the eighth year, Nayancheng and others were ordered to increase frontier garrison troops in the Muslim regions, arrange pay and grain, fix drill regulations, and select two thousand from Kashgar garrison troops for drill; Ili Manchu troops were also to practice mounted archery diligently, supervised by the imperial resident and regional commander.

units.zh: 四十七年，御史錢灃劾山東巡撫國泰、布政使於易簡貪縱營私，命和珅偕都御史劉墉按鞫，灃從往。
units.en: In the forty-seventh year Censor Qian Feng impeached Shandong Governor Guo Tai and Provincial Administration Commissioner Yu Yijian for greed, indulgence, and private profit. He Shen was ordered to join Censor-in-Chief Liu Yong in the investigation, and Qian Feng went along.
units.literal: In the forty-seventh year, Censor Qian Feng impeached Shandong Governor Guo Tai and Provincial Administration Commissioner Yu Yijian for greedy indulgence and private profit; He Shen was ordered to join Censor-in-Chief Liu Yong in investigation; Qian Feng accompanied them.

units.zh: 道光九年，回疆敉定，上太后徽號，緬甸國王遣使進金葉表，創舉也。
units.en: In the ninth year of Daoguang, after the Muslim frontier was pacified and honorific titles were conferred upon the empress dowager, the king of Burma sent envoys presenting a memorial on gold leaf—a first.
units.literal: In the ninth year of Daoguang, after the Muslim frontier was pacified and honorific titles were conferred upon the empress dowager, the king of Burma sent envoys presenting a memorial on gold leaf—a first.

units.zh: 故事，琉球間歲一貢，至十九年，詔改四年為期。
units.en: By precedent, Ryukyu paid tribute every other year; in the nineteenth year an edict changed the interval to four years.
units.literal: By precedent, Ryukyu paid tribute every other year; in the nineteenth year an edict changed the interval to four years.

units.literal: The report was approved.
